name: Mikado Chitose
source:
Chitose is [url=/c10764]Chihaya[/url]'s twin sister. She died of a disease that identical twins are susceptible to at ten years old. She took care of Chihaya during her lifetime. 
[spoiler]She will appear as a ghost and support him also during the game. [/spoiler]

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Otome_wa_Boku_ni_Koishiteru_characters#Otome_wa_Boku_ni_Koishiteru:_Futari_no_Elder]Wikipedia[/url].]
